name: Jiangxi Guoke Defence Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Guoke Defence Group Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, produces and sells military products in China and internationally. The company offers missiles, rockets, solid engine power modules, safety and control modules, ammunition equipment, and fuze and intelligent control products; and civilian products. Its products are used in air defense and anti-missile, armored assault, counter-terrorism and emergency response, marine survey, fire suppression, and other fields. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
